sources: Al Jazeera liveblog, citing a source at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital, Deir el-Balah
fault_line: Ceasefire in name only? Each new Gaza death tests whether the October 2025 ceasefire still means anything on the ground.

sections.what_happened: Israeli gunfire killed a Palestinian young child in Gaza's central city of Deir el-Balah; the girl was reported dead after being shot by Israeli forces positioned east of the city, according to a source at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital speaking to AJ colleagues on the ground. No IDF comment was carried in the liveblog entry.
sections.what_verified: 1 distinct publisher family (AJ T2). Single-source casualty report; consistent with the pattern of Gaza ceasefire-violation deaths recorded through Oct 24, but this death itself is not independently corroborated in-window.
sections.what_disputed: No IDF statement or second outlet corroboration found in-window; the child's name and age were not given in the entry. The entry sits at the exact window boundary (20:00 GMT = 00:00 ) and is recorded here rather than in the 00:00 scan, which closed at that minute.
sections.why_matters: Another child killed in central Gaza as the ceasefire toll keeps rising — one hospital-sourced death, one more test of a truce that has already cost 1,547 lives since it began.
sections.context: Background: NEW to scans (in-window, AJ liveblog 20:00 GMT Oct 24 = 00:00 Oct 25) -- Israeli gunfire kills a Palestinian child in Deir el-Balah, central Gaza

totw_analysis: Our read: Another child killed in central Gaza as the ceasefire toll keeps rising — one hospital-sourced death, one more test of a truce that has already cost 1,547 lives since it began.
